Hello!
This is the Sea Fantasy development team🔥!
Sea Fantasy's first major update!
The additional scenario, "Demon World Edition", will be released at 1:00 a.m. on July 4, 2025(PDT)!
The Demon World Edition is not DLC.
If you have already purchased the game, you can play it by updating the game on the above date and time.
Stay tuned!!

releases.displayName: 🔔Major Update Announcement: About the Demon World Edition

items.text: Hello!
This is the Sea Fantasy development team🔥!
Sea Fantasy's first major update!
The additional scenario “The Demon World” will be released in late June 2025!
There are over 30 Sea'Az to be added in this update!
Episodes about Rod and Axel's fathers and,
New mini-games and more...
This will be a huge update!
Please look forward to it!
Improved the way the Warp Rod is operated when using the controller!
When moving a marker, the character remains still and only the marker can be moved.
Fixed some broken characters in UI

topNew: Improved the way the Warp Rod is operated when using the controller!
When moving a marker, the character remains still and only the marker can be moved.

items.text: We have requested a translation company to re-translate the in-game text that we previously announced, and it has been completed!
The following languages have been re-translated.
・Korean
・Simplified Chinese
・Traditional Chinese
If there are still unnatural translation parts, please let us know on Discord or the community hub.
As previously announced in the news,
we are currently retranslating the game.
The retranslation is currently well underway by an excellent translation company!
It is expected to be completed on February 10, 2025.
An update reflecting the retranslation will be available on or about February 12, 2025!
The dash and cancel key bindings for keyboard operations have been separated.
By default, they are assigned to the following
Dash: Left Shit key
Cancel: Z key
※You can assign the key bindings to any key you like from the settings screen.
The following other improvements have been made
Improved UI for keyboard operation
Enhanced warning display for reset events.
Resumed from before the boss battle when the boss battle is killed in the dungeon part
Adjusted the maximum movement speed in the control panel to twice the speed of the previous version.
Fixed a problem with abnormal acceleration on icy floors when movement speed is increased.
Fixed other minor bugs

items.text: Based on the feedback we received, we have made the following updates
・Some specifications of boss battles were changed (addition of gauge gimmick).
・Added "auto dash" item to the settings.
・Changed pouch function (some frames are no longer editable).
・Fixed a bug related to the display order.
Based on the feedback we received, we have made the following updates
・Reduced jerkiness during character movement.
・Automatic progression of messages has been changed to button progression.
・Fixed other minor bugs.
Based on the feedback we received, we have made the following updates
・Fixed a bug that caused freezing at startup in some regions.
・Improved fish shadow design.
・Adjustments so that at least one material is always acquired.
・Fixed some typos.
・Fixed other minor bugs.
Based on the feedback we received, we have made the following updates
・Adjusted the difficulty level of VS Ballwhale.
・Fixed a bug that the Mega Potion was not displayed correctly when obtaining it.
・Adjusted the price of potions in the store
・Adjusted the appearance of some SeaAZ.
・Changed the effect of the "Horn prawn" fishing bait.
・Added "Bit Fast" and "Bit Slow" to the settings (text display speed).
Based on the feedback we received, we have made the following updates
・Adjusted the volume of VS Fishslime
・Fixed an issue with some areas getting stuck.
・Smoother landing of boats
・Improved the hook rearrangement function.
・Added “Rest” option at inns for inexpensive HP recovery.
・Added “Rest” function at inns for inexpensive HP recovery.
・Fixed a problem where materials could be sold indefinitely.
・Fixed a bug that prevented the sale of fishhooks.
・Fixed other fatal bugs.
